scope: Standing Herbert cottage, with front and back enclosed verandahs, low stumps, hipped roof, side carport and attached rear concrete-block rooms.
era: Standing cottage represented as described in the Queensland Heritage Register after the Herbert-era alterations.

review.notes: The only public-domain Qualla candidate is a portrait of Xavier Herbert. The exterior Qualla photograph requires attribution. The State heritage inventory and its official parcel establish the living cottage, layout and original roof type.
